links.outcome: Prospective silent-mode performance versus bias-corrected scheduled duration
links.effect: Mean CRPS 27.19 min (se 0.016) for model vs 51.66 min (se 0.029) for bias-corrected scheduled duration over 6,173,435 predictions on 62,142 procedures; performance preserved.
links.quote: The mean CRPS across all predictions was 27.19 mins ( se , 0.016 min), compared with 51.66 min ( se , 0.029 min) for the bias-corrected scheduled duration.

links.effect: Weekly CRPS ratio slope 0.0003 per week (95% CI 0.0003–0.0009); no measurable decline; proximally retrained model 27.41 vs primary 27.62 min.
links.quote: Linear regression on this ratio demonstrated a slope of 0.0003 per week (95% confidence interval, 0.0003–0.0009).
